# Goban Studio v11.0.0

v11 is about studying and practising: classics you can learn from, a
straight path from your review to the problems you need, and a fuller
problem bank. v11 reads everything v10 saved.

## Download and first launch

<!-- first-launch -->
| Platform | File | First launch |
| --- | --- | --- |
| macOS (Apple Silicon) | `GobanStudio-macOS-arm64.dmg` or `.zip` | See the package README. |
| macOS (Intel) | `GobanStudio-macOS-x64.dmg` or `.zip` | See the package README. |
| Windows (x64) | `GobanStudio-Windows-x64.zip` | See the package README. |
<!-- /first-launch -->

`SHA256SUMS` lists the checksums of every file. Windows on ARM runs the x64
build under the system's emulation.

## Moments to study in every classic

Each of the twenty classics now opens with 3–5 moments to study. Click one
and the board goes to that move; its note is shown.

- Famous moves are written for the game: the ear-reddening move, Go
  Seigen's 3-3, star point and centre, Shusai's move 160, Lee Sedol's
  move 78, Ke Jie's early 3-3 invasion.
- The others are the game's largest swings. KataGo valued every move of
  every classic (4,554 positions, 400 visits each); a swing shows the
  move KataGo prefers and about how much the move played lost. These are
  estimates, and the note says so.
- A classic opens on its famous move, or else its first moment.

## From your review to practice

A takeaway in the game summary that names a kind of mistake ("Key
mistakes that look like “Cut”: 2") now has a *Practise these* link. It opens an unsolved
problem of that kind near your level; *Next* stays with that kind.

## A fuller problem bank

81 new solver-proved problems (624 in all). Every grade now has at least
15 problems each of capture, save, life, kill and endgame, including new
sente, reverse sente and gote endgame problems.

## Smaller changes

- A classic's year in its toolbar subtitle (1846, not the list of playing
  days).
- New game remembers your board size unless the level picks it.
- Unused code and fourteen unused interface strings are gone.

## Known limits

- The builds are not code-signed (no certificates yet). The update
  checksum guards against damaged or wrong downloads; it is not a
  signature.
- Not yet checked by people: a usability test, a strong player's review of
  the course, the new problems and the classics' notes, a native-speaker
  review of the Chinese, Korean and Japanese text, and a real
  screen-reader session.
- A classic's swings come from one search of 400 visits per position; a
  single number can be off by a point or so.
- The new problems all have Black to play.
- *Try again* needs KataGo (the desktop app); the browser preview has no
  KataGo.
- The KataGo check of the course leaves some steps for a human.
- The counting solver ignores ko threats; endgame problems avoid ko.
